The state property should compute the effective state: if _state is OPEN and the timeout has elapsed, return HALF_OPEN — no need for a timer thread.
In _on_failure(), a failure in HALF_OPEN must send the circuit straight back to OPEN (same as reaching the threshold). Check for both conditions.
Reset the failure count when the circuit opens and when it closes. If you don't reset on open, the first failure in a new CLOSED phase incorrectly inherits the old count.
